ticket_number_extraction.description: Ticket number is typically a bold 5-8 digit number near the top right of the ticket.

notes.usage: Fallback profile used when no specific supplier profile matches. Logs the supplier to unknown_suppliers.txt so a dedicated profile can be created later.
notes.ticket_number: Ticket number is 5-8 digits; the region scan covers the right half of the top quarter. AI vision is the primary extraction method.
notes.facility: The facility is where the material originated (quarry/pit/plant), not the customer receiving the delivery.
